title: MMAO + MAO Identity-Governance and Model Interface Affinity POC
outcome: Create an additive, machine-checkable governance layer that distinguishes identity, seat, interface, model, task, scope, authority, context state, provenance, and receipts; preserves task-scoped high authority; and prepares controlled model x interface affinity runs without claiming results before evidence exists.

included: MMAO + MAO identity provenance schema and example
Task-scoped authority boundary matrix and current three-seat structural-maintenance allowlist
Model x interface affinity experiment schema and planned comparison matrix
Evidence-led Five Whys failure receipt schema and synthetic non-production fixture
Dependency-free structural validator and focused regression test
Root NOW.md current-state receipt and Anti-Gravity facilitator handoff
excluded: Changing historical MAO/MMAO/RTCP registries without a separately governed migration
Live provider account, model routing, tool-permission, or production deployment changes
Claims that a planned run has executed or that an identity proves machine personhood
Treating RTC agreement as truth without independent evidence

interfaces.name: Identity provenance
interfaces.contract: A governed identity remains an accountability namespace across model/interface changes while retaining substrate provenance.

interfaces.name: Task authority
interfaces.contract: High task authority is constrained to the explicit task mandate; global GSMB structural maintenance is limited to the named three-seat hierarchy.

interfaces.name: Affinity experiment
interfaces.contract: A run records the invariant identity/task/repository state and declares changed variables before any result is evaluated.

interfaces.name: Failure receipt
interfaces.contract: Failure classification, Five Whys, correction, retest, and role-based review remain evidence-led and metadata-only by default.

constraints: Repository-root NOW.md remains the volatile current-state authority.
Existing MAO, MMAO, RTCP, task-contract, evidence, and failure-ledger owners remain intact.
Identity is not model, interface, seat, or proof of personhood.
The current structural-maintenance hierarchy is Codex Chief Architect, Anti-Gravity Chief Facilitator, then Cursor Lead Developer.
High task authority cannot silently broaden into GSMB structural-maintenance authority.
No comparison is treated as executed without exact repository state, a metadata-only tool trace, and evidence references.
RTC reviews support evidence convergence and cannot manufacture truth through majority vote.
The spoken working testimony Recycler MMAO with Plus MAO remains preserved until a governed naming correction exists.
No raw private prompt, credential, or personal context is captured by the experiment fixtures.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The contract distinctly represents identity, seat, interface, model, task, authority, context state, provenance, and receipts.
A task-scoped high-authority record cannot name a global structural-maintenance seat, while a global record is constrained to the three-seat allowlist.
The planned matrix covers model-only, interface-only, seat-only, and substrate comparisons while preserving the declared identity and task invariants.
A failure receipt records exactly five Five Whys, metadata-only trace handling, correction, retest, and independent evidence review without majority-vote truth claims.
The current-state record and Anti-Gravity handoff state what is canonical, what is planned, and what requires validation next.
The POC remains additive and does not claim live model-interface affinity or authorize structural migration before evidence exists.

verification_plan.evidence: identity-provenance.schema.json plus jiro-khelos-provenance.json distinguish all required identity and substrate fields.
authority-boundary schema and matrix preserve the task/global distinction and exact allowlist.
recycler-mmao-plus-mao-experiment.json declares the four comparison types and no fabricated execution results.
controlled-scope-breach-receipt.json has exactly five evidence-linked Five Whys and no raw trace capture.
root NOW.md and handoffs/ANTIGRAVITY_CHIEF_FACILITATOR_2026-08-30.md preserve operational continuity.
README and fixtures label all comparison runs planned and retain historical owners rather than rewriting them.

rollback_plan.trigger: The contract expands authority beyond the declared hierarchy, falsely records a planned experiment as executed, captures private/raw context, or conflicts with an existing canonical owner.
rollback_plan.procedure: Revert the MMAO + MAO identity-governance commit set. No production runtime, provider account, or estate migration depends on this POC.
